scope: Physical admissibility for the WP-12 Phase 5 benchmark v1 (spec 5.3 class 'physically_unsupported') of law 8, tlmpm_v5, ruler_knife_v2_y at 1 mm / 4 mm / 0.1 ms, kinematic ideal tracking unless a note says Native, with the WP-12 goal planner and controller_profile path_v2 (armed through-cut end 0.1-0.3 mm above the board top; measured 0.16-0.28 mm in E2 and Phase 2b; the frozen v1 controller ends 0.3-0.5 mm above and is a KNOWN FAILURE for pieces <= 10 mm). INSIDE a bound means 'not declared physically unsupported, admissible for execution', NOT 'validated': each rule's note splits its admissible range into VALIDATED, PARTIALLY_VALIDATED, NOT_RUN and the excluded KNOWN_FAILURE / UNSUPPORTED_BY_LAW / PHYSICALLY_INFEASIBLE / KINEMATICALLY_INFEASIBLE parts. A bound is set at the edge of the first known failure or physical limit, or at the outermost value reviewed, with ONE declared exception: a bound may contain a named KNOWN_FAILURE point when the decision declares the interval an OOD boundary study (rule sever_tilt_solid_board); samples there are executed and measured, never ID, never in a target and never a demo. The Phase 5 ID uses only the cells listed in phase5_id_rules (same rule schema, bounds = validated cells); generalization_wp12.freeze_problems checks the admissible bounds (including 'when' rules) and every declared ID sample against 'rules'; phase5_id_rules is checked by the freeze decision script and the proposed CPU test. Samples outside a bound are physically_unsupported, never dropped and never counted as controller failures. Material parameters are provisional and uncalibrated; forces are not resolution-converged; every validated cell is one kinematic run per point (seed 42, one 160 x 30 x 20 mm bar, one lattice phase) unless stated.

rule_semantics.parameter: a key of the sample's envelope_parameters (generalization_wp12.envelope_parameters); a rule whose parameter the sample does not carry is NOT_APPLICABLE
rule_semantics.when: optional {parameter: value} conditions; the rule applies only if every condition equals the sample's value
rule_semantics.kind: max: value <= max | min: value >= min | range: min <= value <= max | in_set: value in values | subset: every element of the value list is in values
rule_semantics.null_bound: a null bound is UNDECLARED: the rule is NOT_EVALUATED and the sample is marked envelope_pending (never silently supported or unsupported)
rule_semantics.evidence: the record that justifies the bound (report section, evidence file, commit)
